prompt: I just dropped the new Meta export in data/raw/meta/ — can you run the full analysis on it?

assertions.name: validation_status_green
assertions.description: Run summary or report output contains GREEN validation status (not YELLOW or RED)

assertions.name: account_name_inferred_correctly
assertions.description: Output files or run summary reference 'account_dental' as the account name

assertions.name: five_reports_generated
assertions.description: At least 5 .md report files are present in the outputs directory

assertions.name: five_action_csvs_generated
assertions.description: At least 5 .csv action files are present in the outputs directory

assertions.name: high_priority_actions_present
assertions.description: At least one action CSV contains rows with priority=High

assertions.name: [product_e]_reactivation_surfaced
assertions.description: At least one output references [Product E] campaign reactivation or paused [Product E] lead gen
